title: codonopsis pilosula var. modesta
intro: Codonopsis pilosula var. modesta, commonly known as Dongling Ginseng, is a type of plant that belongs to the Campanulaceae family and is native to China. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries to promote health and well-being, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Codonopsis pilosula var. modesta include its ability to tonify the Qi, promote digestion, and improve respiratory function. Bioactive constituents of the plant include saponins, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
